Welcome to Kettlewick

Thanks for joining. We are a two-person roastery on Wharf Lane in Port Ellery, and we roast every Tuesday.

That means the coffee you order this week was still green a few days before it reaches your door.

Your welcome code

FIRSTROAST

What to expect
1

One email a month

Roast notes arrives on the first Friday with new coffees and one brew tip. Nothing in between unless you order.
2

Roasted Tuesday, posted Wednesday

Order by Monday night and your bag leaves the roastery the morning after it was roasted.
3

Help from a person

Reply to any email and Mara or Theo will answer, usually the same day.

See you on roast day,
Mara Quill, head roaster
